verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents first-party data sharing with other clusters: consumers get read-only access with real-time revocable permissions, and no cluster credentials or compute are exposed. Its compute–storage separation suggests the shared data is not copied, but the docs never say so for sharing, and they say 'other clusters' rather than other accounts or organizations. Missing for 10: explicit cross-account/cross-organization sharing, an explicit zero-copy guarantee for shared datasets, a statement that shared data stays live/real-time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can share live datasets with another account or organization without copying data or building an export pipeline

citations.quote: Share your data with other clusters... without exposing any cluster credentials or sharing its compute... read-only access with real-time revocable permissions.
